text_blocks.snippet: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a group of lung disorders characterized by inflammation and scarring (fibrosis) of the lung tissue, primarily around the air sacs (alveoli). There are many potential causes, including environmental and occupational exposures, autoimmune diseases, medications, and genetics. Some types of ILD, like idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, have no known cause.
